changes.to: The maker's exhibit entry for YMBot C2 describes bionic bipedal walking, dual 6-DoF arms, bionic skin, dexterous hands, fine expression actuation and multimodal LLM voice interaction; it publishes no height, weight, DoF, payload, speed, runtime or price, so those fields are empty.
Yunmu Intelligent Manufacturing's YMBot C2: a bionic-skin bipedal humanoid with two 6-DoF arms, dexterous hands and expression actuation for cultural-tourism and exhibition guidance.
